description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5360013630604 SPRING,HELICAL,COMP: Line 0001 Qty 124 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0064 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
